waypoints.name: Hannegan Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Glacier, drive the Mount Baker Highway (SR-542) east about 12.5 miles and turn left onto Hannegan Pass Road (FS Road 32). Follow it 5.3 miles to the road-end parking at the Hannegan Trailhead. A recreation pass such as the Northwest Forest Pass is required to park, and a North Cascades National Park backcountry permit is required for camps inside the park.
